summary: Stripe payments integration verified end-to-end with the newly provisioned Emergent-managed Stripe sandbox keys in backend/.env. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_checkout.py — POST /api/payments/checkout returns a valid checkout.stripe.com URL and cs_test_* session_id for coin packages (small_talk, popular), custom usd_amount=20, premium_monthly (payment mode), vip_monthly (subscription mode); the endpoint 400s unknown packages and custom usd_amount=0, requires Bearer auth (401/403 without token). GET /api/payments/status/{sid} returns the record (pending/unpaid for new session, 404 for unknown). Fixed stale admin password (Admin@12345 -> Admin@GD24!) and stale default BASE_URL in that test file. The companion test_payments.py was not run in this iteration (it registers a new user and uses an outdated preview URL default; parametrized across 8 package ids and should also pass against the new keys — flagged for next iteration if needed). Frontend end-to-end on https://gd24-preview.preview.emergentagent.com using testuser@giftsdates.com / Test@12345: (1) /wallet Top up -> clicked topup-package-small_talk -> redirected to Stripe hosted checkout (Link + Card accordion UI). Clicked `card-accordion-item-button`, filled 4242 4242 4242 4242 / 12/34 / 123, Cardholder=Test User, Country=Canada, Postal=M5V 3A8. Clicked `hosted-payment-submit-button` -> redirected to /payment/success?session_id=cs_test_... -> PaymentSuccess page polled /api/payments/status/{sid} and switched to 'Payment successful' with the CheckCircle icon, and refreshUser() ran. Wallet balance went from 0 to 100 coins (small_talk pack grants 100 coins) and nav bar coin pill updated to 100. (2) /wallet?vip=1 -> clicked `vip-subscribe-confirm` -> redirected to Stripe (subscription mode, no address required). Filled same card -> redirected back to /payment/success -> 'Payment successful' displayed. Wallet now renders `vip-subscription-card` with 'Your VIP membership expires on: 11/13/2026', '🔁 Auto-charges your card each month', and the Cancel auto-renewal button; VIP badge appears in the nav bar. The webhook/stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve fallback in /api/payments/status is what fulfils the grant here (no public webhook was hit in test), and it is idempotent (fulfilled flag on payment_transactions). Note: the Stripe checkout page shows a banner 'This page is from an unclaimed Stripe sandbox. No real payments are processed.' — this is expected for the provisioned sandbox and payments still complete successfully in test mode.

issues: Minor a11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on both Top-up and Premium Radix dialogs. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4349-4415 /payments/checkout correctly branches modes: payment for coins + premium (one-time, with Emergent SMP managed_payments={enabled:true} and automatic_tax fallback on InvalidRequestError 'managed payments'/'ineligible'), subscription for vip_monthly with subscription_data.metadata so webhook renewals carry user_id. Enforces custom_min_usd (returns 400) before creating session. Good.

server.py:4458-4475 /payments/status is a safe fallback for when the webhook hasn't fired yet: it retrieves the Stripe session and marks the local transaction paid, then calls idempotent _fulfill(). This is what the frontend PaymentSuccess polling relies on and was observed working end-to-end.

server.py:4417-4456 _fulfill is idempotent via the 'fulfilled' flag; grants coins via $inc, extends premium_until by 30 days (preserving existing future date), and for VIP extends both premium_until and vip_until plus sets *_auto_renew=true. Confirmed by UI showing both Premium and VIP cards post-VIP purchase.

server.py:4477-4533 /stripe/webhook validates signature with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and persists stripe_subscription_id/stripe_customer_id for VIP so invoice.paid can extend and invoice.payment_failed can flip vip_auto_renew=false — well structured.
Wallet.jsx:33-38 buy() posts to /payments/checkout with origin_url=window.location.origin and does window.location.href=data.checkout_url — simple and correct; error toast on failure.

PaymentResult.jsx polls every 2s up to 20 tries (40s) which worked in the sandbox; could be made longer or event-driven in prod if Stripe webhooks are delayed, but current fallback via /payments/status is adequate.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (coin top-up + VIP subscription both complete end-to-end with test card 4242; balance and VIP badge update)
